messages:
Priya Patel: FYI pods in eu-west-1 are flapping; readiness probes failing because /metrics times out. Not seeing obvious app errors. :thinking:
Miguel Torres: @Priya any recent firewall/NACL changes? last deploy touched node labels only, AFAIK.
Priya Patel: I checked the service, target groups are healthy, but the node exporter scraping fails with connection refused from the collectors.
Sam Wu: grabbing logs and trying curl from a jump host into node exporter port 9100.
Sam Wu: from bastion: `curl -sv http://10.10.45.12:9100/metrics` -> attempts hang.
Lila Brooks: Could be egress/NAT. Are these nodes in a private subnet that needs a NAT gateway for outbound health collectors?
Miguel Torres: We run prometheus in same VPC but in another AZ, should be cross-subnet allowed. Check SGs and NACLs.
Priya Patel: Checked SGs: node SG allows inbound 9100 from prometheus SG. Outbound is set to `Custom - 10.0.0.0/8` only. That seems suspect.
Miguel Torres: aha. outbound being restricted would prevent node from responding to some health callbacks? Usually responses use ephemeral ports back to the client; if outbound is limited, that could block TCP handshake completion.
Lila Brooks: Can you paste the NACL for the subnet?
Priya Patel: NACL for subnet-0a1b2c3d: `Inbound: allow 80,443 from 0.0.0.0/0; deny ephemeral (1024-65535)`. `Outbound: allow 1024-65535 to 10.0.0.0/8; deny 0.0.0.0/0`.
Miguel Torres: Whoa that's backwards. Outbound denies internet and inbound denies ephemeral ports, so cross-AZ response flows get dropped unless within 10.0.0.0/8. Prometheus nodes are 10.20.x.x so they should match, but some infra (metrik collectors) are in 172.31.x.x -> blocked.
Sam Wu: I also see a recent change in terraform https://git.company/repo/infra/commit/ab12cd that tightened NACLs per request from security. Will revert for the monitoring subnets.
Priya Patel: Workaround: can we add an SG rule to allow outbound 1024-65535 to prometheus SG? Not all traffic has same SG membership.
Lila Brooks: SGs are stateful, so adding outbound ephemeral to prometheus SG should fix. But NACLs are stateless and will still block if the source IP space isn't allowed. Need both.
infra-bot: deploy pipeline triggered: terraform plan for revert-pr/monitoring-nacls by Sam Wu at 2025-12-01T10:04:00Z :white_check_mark:
Miguel Torres: Also found NAT gateway route table for those private subnets missing the 0.0.0.0/0 -> nat-abc123 route. So outbound internet egress for updates / package fetches also broken.
Priya Patel: That explains the image pull slowdown earlier. Are we sure NAT route wasn't intentionally removed?
Sam Wu: Security ticket asked to limit egress but team accidentally applied the change to monitoring subnets. I put up a quick plan to: 1) add outbound SG ephemeral to prometheus SG, 2) update NACL to allow ephemeral ranges for prometheus CIDRs, 3) restore NAT route for private subnets.
Lila Brooks: Do step 1 as hotfix, step 2/3 with TF revert and rollout. Hotfix SG change should be fine.
Priya Patel: Hotfix applied: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0f12 --protocol tcp --port 1024-65535 --destination-group sg-0a9b --region eu-west-1`
Miguel Torres: Tests: curl from bastion -> success, prometheus scraping resumes.
Priya Patel: Observability: node readiness returns green, cluster autoscaler stopped retrying.
Sam Wu: Filing postmortem and tagging security for the mistaken NACL push. Also adding a guard in CI to prevent NACLs that deny ephemeral ports unless explicitly approved.
Lila Brooks: Follow-up: we should have an automation test that runs a cross-subnet TCP handshake matrix after NACL changes.
Priya Patel: Agree. Thanks all :thumbsup:
infra-bot: incident created: INC-2025-1134 "Monitoring scrape failures in eu-west-1 due to NACL/SG misconfigs" assigned to eng-infra
Sam Wu: I'll leave the TF revert PR and link it in the ticket: https://git.company/repo/infra/pull/402
Miguel Torres: Closing loop: need a postmortem in /postmortems with timeline and remedial fixes.
Priya Patel: I'll draft it this afternoon and link to the incident.
Lila Brooks: Great job catching it quickly.
Priya Patel: marking as resolved in slack for now :white_check_mark:
